column1: # The Photographer (scripts/enemies/tourist_brain.gd): id, seconds, destination, prompt.

column4: A chubby middle-aged man humming a cheerful old holiday tune to himself, out of tune, breathy, through a smile, slowly, outdoors at night in a forest about ten metres away, loopable, no music.
A middle-aged man giggling quietly to himself, delighted, high and breathy, as if he just got a very good photo, outdoors at night, no music.
An old film camera's advance lever cranked twice by thumb, ratcheting clicks and a soft whirr of film moving, close, no music.
A 1980s film camera rewinding its film with a long whining motor buzz that ends with a click, outdoors at night, no music.
An instant camera ejecting a photo: a motor whirr and the print sliding out, then a man flapping the photo in the air three times, close, no music.
A hard plastic camera body tapping three times on a window pane from outside, the glass rattling slightly in its frame, heard from inside a quiet room, no music.
A man breathing heavily through his nose right against a window pane from outside, the glass fogging, a soft squeak of a cheek against glass, heard from inside a room, no music.
Heavy hiking boots walking quickly on gravel and dry pine needles, six steps, outdoors at night, about eight metres away, no music.
A small electric lens zoom motor whirring in and out on an old compact camera, close, no music.
A loud camera flash pop heard through a window from inside a small wooden room, a sharp electric snap with the glass buzzing, no music.
